input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN \"AS IS\" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX puts the Licensed Technology on an \"AS IS\" basis and disclaims all warranties, express or implied, and expressly disclaims that nonconformity to Documentation can or will be corrected. There is no affirmative performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the Agreement: the only related obligation is Article VII(f), under which Licensor uses \"commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections\", which is not a warranty and carries no repair/replace or refund remedy (and Article VII(h) further limits it). That is the walk-away position, so we redline to the fallback: a 90-day software conformance warranty, a 30-day services warranty, and repair or replacement or refund remedies, together with a carve-out of the express warranty from both disclaimer sentences so it is not swallowed.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day software conformance warranty and 30-day services warranty with repair/replacement or refund, and carve the express warranty out of the AS IS disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article VIX currently provides the Licensed Technology "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, which is our walk-away position, so we added a short express warranty at our fallback level: 90 days conformance to Documentation for the Licensed Software, 30 days for the support services, with repair or replacement or a refund of fees paid. We also carved that warranty out of the two disclaimer sentences so it is not swallowed.
